scheme_name: प्रधानमंत्री कृषि सिंचाई योजना – Per Drop More Crop
scheme_name_english: PMKSY – Per Drop More Crop / Micro Irrigation
department: Kisan Kalyan and Agriculture Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
benefits: Financial assistance is provided for eligible micro-irrigation systems. The official MP scheme page states 55% of the unit cost for small and marginal farmers and 45% for other farmers.
eligibility: Farmers who meet the current scheme conditions are eligible.
required_documents: Other documents as required by the department
application_process: Farmers can apply through the official DBT agriculture portal. Beneficiary selection is carried out according to the procedure specified by the Agriculture Department.
source_type: MP Government CM Helpline Scheme Dashboard
